Gaming.Title: Gaming mode
Gaming.Subtitle: One click: maximum performance, free memory, quiet background – plus live FPS and a report after every session.
Gaming.MeasureHint: Switch to your game – the FPS of the foreground window are measured.
Gaming.RestoreHint: When you stop, everything is restored and you get a session report.
Gaming.CloseAppsHint: Selected programs are closed on boost – unsaved data in them will be lost.
Gaming.NoSessions: No sessions yet – start the boost before playing.
Cleaner.Title: Storage cleaner
Cleaner.Subtitle: Finds unnecessary files and removes them safely – personal data stays untouched.
Cleaner.Status.DoneSkipped: Done! {0} freed · {1} files were in use
Cleaner.Confirm.Title: Start cleanup?
Cleaner.Confirm.Message: {0} in {1} files will be permanently deleted. Files currently in use are skipped automatically.
Cleaner.Confirm.DeepClean: Deep clean uses Windows' built-in tools (DISM / Disk Cleanup) and can take several minutes. Please don't close EZTool in the meantime.
Cleaner.Confirm.Running: Note: Some programs are still running (e.g. browsers). Close them for a better result.
Cleaner.SafeModeHint: Safe mode: only known cache and temp locations. Locked files and links (junctions) are never touched.
Cleaner.Rule.UserTemp.Name: Temporary files (user)
Cleaner.Rule.UserTemp.Description: Leftovers from installers and programs in the TEMP folder. Only files older than 24 hours.
Cleaner.Rule.WinTemp.Name: Temporary files (Windows)
Cleaner.Rule.WinTemp.Description: Windows' system-wide temp folder. Only files older than 24 hours.
Cleaner.Rule.WuCache.Name: Windows Update cache
Cleaner.Rule.WuCache.Description: Update packages that are already installed. Windows downloads them again if needed.
Cleaner.Rule.DeliveryOpt.Name: Delivery Optimization
Cleaner.Rule.DeliveryOpt.Description: Cached update files for peer-to-peer distribution.
Cleaner.Rule.Crash.Name: Crash reports & memory dumps
Cleaner.Rule.Crash.Description: Error reports (WER), minidumps and crash dumps from programs.
Cleaner.Rule.Thumbs.Name: Thumbnail cache
Cleaner.Rule.Thumbs.Description: Explorer preview images. They are recreated automatically.
Cleaner.Rule.WinLogs.Name: Windows logs
Cleaner.Rule.WinLogs.Description: Old log files from Windows components (older than 14 days).
Cleaner.Rule.Recycle.Name: Recycle Bin
Cleaner.Rule.Recycle.Description: Permanently empties the Recycle Bin on all drives.
Cleaner.Rule.Browser.Name: {0} – Cache
Cleaner.Rule.Browser.Description: Cached website data. History, passwords and cookies stay untouched.
Cleaner.Rule.AppsCache.Name: App caches (Discord, Steam, VS Code, Teams …)
Cleaner.Rule.AppsCache.Description: Web caches of Electron- and Chromium-based programs.
Cleaner.Rule.Shader.Name: Graphics shader cache
Cleaner.Rule.Shader.Description: DirectX, NVIDIA and AMD shaders. Rebuilt automatically – games may load a little longer on first start.
Cleaner.Rule.DevCache.Name: Developer caches (npm, pip, Yarn)
Cleaner.Rule.DevCache.Description: Package caches of developer tools. Packages are downloaded again when needed.
Cleaner.Rule.WinSxS.Name: Old Windows updates (component store)
Cleaner.Rule.WinSxS.Description: Removes system components superseded by newer updates via DISM. Safe, but takes 5–20 minutes. Installed updates can still be uninstalled.
Cleaner.Rule.WindowsOld.Name: Previous Windows installation (Windows.old)
Cleaner.Rule.WindowsOld.Description: Left behind after a major Windows update. Afterwards, rolling back to the old version is no longer possible.
StorageMap.Title: Storage map
StorageMap.Subtitle: Your drive as a map: the bigger the tile, the more space it takes. Click to zoom in, right-click to go back.
StorageMap.HoverHint: Hover over a tile for details.
StorageMap.BrowseTitle: Choose a folder for the storage map
StorageMap.Done: Done in {0:0.0} s – hover over a tile for details.
StorageMap.EmptyTitle: Choose a drive and create the map
StorageMap.EmptyText: A whole drive takes 30 seconds to a few minutes, depending on its size.
Folders.Title: Folder analysis
Folders.Subtitle: Find large, long-unused, empty or orphaned folders – and move them safely to the Recycle Bin.
Folders.ResultHint: Choose a mode and start the analysis.
Folders.Mode.Stale.Hint: Finds folders whose contents haven't changed in a long time. Program and system folders are skipped – please remove programs via “Programs”.
Folders.Mode.Orphans.Hint: Searches AppData and ProgramData for folders that no longer match any installed program. Please check before deleting – nothing is preselected.
Folders.Mode.Empty.Hint: Finds folders without files (including those with only empty subfolders).
Folders.NothingFound: Nothing found – everything is tidy here. ✨
Folders.Confirm.Title: Move to Recycle Bin?
Folders.Confirm.Message: {0} folders ({1}) will be moved to the Recycle Bin. You can restore them from there at any time.
Folders.Recycled: {0} folders moved to the Recycle Bin
Folders.EmptyText: Everything you delete goes to the Recycle Bin and can be restored.
Duplicates.Title: Duplicates
Duplicates.Subtitle: Finds duplicate photos, videos, music and documents – compared byte by byte, not just by name.
Duplicates.ResultHint: Choose a location and start the search.
Duplicates.NoneFound: No duplicates found – everything is unique. ✨
Duplicates.KeepOne.Title: Keep at least one copy
Duplicates.KeepOne.Message: All copies are selected in {0} group(s). Please leave at least one file in each group.
Duplicates.Confirm.Title: Move duplicates to Recycle Bin?
Duplicates.Confirm.Message: {0:N0} files ({1}) will be moved to the Recycle Bin. At least one copy remains in each group.
Duplicates.Recycled: {0:N0} duplicates moved to the Recycle Bin
Duplicates.SafeHint: The actual content is compared (SHA-256). The original is always kept, deleted files go to the Recycle Bin. Cloud files are not downloaded.
Duplicates.EmptyText: Tip: “Pictures” or “Videos” in your user folder often yield the most.
